Wrap Visualizer

Upload a photo of your own car or pick a popular model, then preview hundreds of 3M, Avery Dennison, KPMF and ORACAL colour-change films with real reflections and shading. Compare before and after, then send the build to us for a custom quote.

Loading the visualizer…

Using the visualizer

Preview a colour, then get a real quote.

Choose your type of vehicle, then browse colour-change films from 3M, Avery Dennison, KPMF and ORACAL by colour and finish — gloss, satin, matte, metallic and colour-shift. Add a window tint shade and a wheel colour to see the whole look, and send the build to us for a quote.

A screen can only approximate a film. Colour, metallic flake and colour-shift effects look different in daylight, so compare physical samples before you commit — the 3M 2080 and Avery SW900 ranges are sampled at our Vaughan shop. A colour-change wrap protects the factory paint underneath and comes off cleanly from OEM paint when you want the original colour back.

Ready to price it? See colour change wraps, use the wrap cost estimator or read wrap vs paint to compare the options. Every install is backed by our 5-year workmanship warranty.

FAQ

Visualizer questions

Are the colours on screen accurate?
They are a close guide, but every screen shows colour differently and metallic or colour-shift films change with the light. Compare physical samples at the shop before you commit.
How do I get a quote for the colour I picked?
When you are happy with the build, send it to us from the visualizer with your vehicle details. We reply with a quote for the film and coverage you chose, usually within one business day.
